init_distributed_mode: initialize distributed training mode for single GPU, multi-GPU, multi-node, or SLURM jobs using params object
all_gather: gather picklable data from all GPU ranks into a single list during distributed training
accumulate_predictions_from_multiple_gpu: synchronize and merge prediction dictionaries from multiple GPUs into one combined predictions dict
synchronize: synchronize all processes with a barrier during distributed training to ensure all ranks reach the same point
init_signal_handler: install signal handlers for SLURM job preemption and SIGTERM bypass during distributed training
